name: Legionfarm
long_description:
LFCarry (formerly Legionfarm) is the world's top AI-powered marketplace for gamers to hire elite pros (top 1%) for coaching, carry and companionship services in AAA games like WoW, Destiny 2, CoD, and Apex Legends. Founded in 2016, YC-backed (W20) with $17.8M raised from 20+ investors, we've served 250k+ customers via two web platforms and five bots, creating 10k+ jobs for Pros worldwide.

We turn gaming hobbies into careers, delivering global entertainment and esports impact. Since 2023, our LLM-driven automation replaced 100+ ops roles, with an AI workspace featuring smart agents, real-time feedback, evals, and community fine-tuning for peak pro efficiency.

founders.title: Founder/CMO
founders.founder_bio: YC W20 founder, product and growth leader building production AI agent fleets. LFCarry / Legionfarm: $45M+ lifetime sales, $17.8M raised; CEO until May 2024. Led AI transformation from 140 people to 3 supervising agents. Built OrderHub orchestration loops. CoreCraft AI acquired by Portal AI; 3 later product contracts. ManyChat: 5-month contract, 5 agents, ~$2M ARR added. AGI House: research and matching for 13,619 profiles.
